title: Self-audit Finding
description: One row in the structured audit report. Mechanical checks emit Findings directly; skill checkpoints emit Findings of kind=checkpoint.

id.description: Stable id (sha-shortish) so the same finding across runs is comparable.

stage.description: Pipeline stage that produced this finding (matches audit-pipeline.yaml::stages[].id).

kind.description: mechanical = concrete violation; checkpoint = agent must apply a skill

files.description: File paths the finding applies to (relative to repo root)

skill.description: For checkpoint kind, the skill the agent should load.

remediation.description: Concrete one-line action the user/agent should take.
